decisions.reason: This low-cost accessory sat on its own page through 2019 and uses few resources, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is little reason to start a search for other uses of them.
This box car series is core trailer business and was shown on the home page in both observed years, which suggests it meets aspirations, so management has no trigger to drop it.
This car transporter is a niche product kept on its own page through 2019, and the firm's slack can carry it while demand is uncertain, though it is more exposed than the core series.
The low-bed series is a featured core line with steady visibility on the home page, so it most likely performs at or near aspiration and will be kept.
High covers are a complementary line that sells alongside the trailer range and was featured on the home page, so dropping it would bring little benefit.
This second box car series was also featured on the home page, but it may overlap with Product B and could be consolidated if results fall short, so its drop risk is slightly higher.
